name: Tonia Arey
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 6

items.text: Tonia Arey is a realtor running for Seat 6 on the Los Angeles Community College District Board of Trustees. She supports increasing campus safety and expanding career education. She wants to review the district’s budget to identify waste and duplication. She proposes cutting administrative expenses before classroom instruction and using underutilized district property to raise revenue.
